reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

title.narrative: EaP Women in Business FW - Credo Bank Women in Business loan

description.narrative: Up to USD 4 million, local currency denominated, three year Women in Business (WIB) credit line to Credo Bank. This will be the first WiB project between EBRD and Credo, therefore adding one more participant to WiB framework. Lending to women and women-led businesses has always been at the core of bank's business, more than a half (by number) and up to 45% (by volume) of Credo's loan book has a female gender tag. WiB will continue promoting women entrepreneurship and women participation in business by building or improving efficiency of respective entities through expertise and advisory services (ASB) provided under the framework. Credo will be the third bank and financial institution to join the programme in Georgia.
